Still the Best Beef Pho in HCMC
Sep 2024 • Solo
Pho Hung beef pho is still the best in HCMC. 
This round I ordered Pho Hung Đặc Biệt 90,000 VND, which is Pho Hung special soup consisting of round steak, flank, flat brisket, soft tendon, flank crispy flank, cartilage, beef broth meatballs, honeycomb tripe, With all these ingredients the broth taste super delicious 🤤. 
At VND 90,000 it’s sure value for money with the generous serving.

The restaurant releases hot, toxic gas that poisons people
Nov 2023 • Family
Heat and toxic exhaust gases are released day and night into people's houses, causing coughing, difficulty breathing, burning eyes and nose... poisoning neighboring houses day and night!! . The exhaust gas is very toxic, so the shop owner does not dare to inhale it, but instead invests in a large-scale exhaust system to discharge it to the next house so that customers entering the shop cannot detect it and praise the coolness of the shop?! The shop owner declared "discharge at all costs" so people complained for a long time but nothing was done. What is it about pho broth that "just reheats, not cooks" and releases such a strong smell, inhaling it makes your arms and legs weak, you feel nervous, you have difficulty breathing, you can't stand it.

Delicious Pho
Nov 2019
Our local tour guide recommended this place to us. We are so glad we made time to check it out. Pho was delicious. You know the soup itself is good when you don’t need to add anything else to it (sriracha/hoisin). Love all the herbs and chilis they serve with it. Generous portions of meat and very tender. Noodles were great. Definitely one of the best phos we’ve ever had!
